# Securely
> AI-assisted Windows screen threat monitor (OCR + OpenRouter). $3/month via Stripe.

## Notes
Securely is assistive security software, not a guarantee against all phishing.
There is no free Starter tier — the live plan is $3/month. Canonical host: https://trysecurely.com (Vercel alias: https://trysecurely.vercel.app).
